thread:
Alice M.: Heads up — saw a cluster-wide tail latency spike ~10:42 UTC, p95 for short requests jumped from ~180ms -> ~1.2s around 1769004300. Deployed profiler snapshot attached.

DevBot: Incident created INC-2026-045 — latency spike detected in serving-runtime. Pager duty: Ben (on-call).

Ben (on-call): Looking now. Any recent deploys/rollouts? Model or runtime?

Alice M.: Small runtime tweak for kernel-selection rolled at 1769003600 — enabled 'auto_kernel_pref' for some Llama variants. No model changes.

Carla: Quick profiler dump and counters: 
```
perf_summary: kernel_switches:+28% | avg_batch: 48 -> 210 | KV_cache_miss_rate: 2% -> 32%
hot_kernels: tiled-gemm-v2 (68%), fallback: generic-gemm (32%)
node_mem_pressure: 78% -> 95%
```

Ben (on-call): avg_batch ~210 ??? That's huge. Which service is sending massive batched requests?

Alice M.: We saw a burst of long-context chat sessions from customer-prod-xyz — client replay suggests they switched from streaming to bulk chunking (SDK change). Batching heuristic didn't cap growth due to bug in exponential backoff.

Carla: KV cache eviction log also shows big churn — many small sessions caused cold KVs, causing longer generation times and forcing kernel fallback. Hypothesis: large batches + KV misses -> fallback kernels with worse latency.

infra-bot: GPU node g-10-4 reported high memory pressure; cgroup throttling triggered at 1769004475. Possible noisy neighbor on the same host.

Ben (on-call): Mitigation plan (short-term): 1) Flip feature flag `runtime.dynamic_batch_cap=false` to enforce hard cap 64. 2) Route customer-prod-xyz to smaller model variant (llama-7b-quant) until they patch. 3) Enable tenant-level KV prefetch for them. 4) Start rolling rollback of 'auto_kernel_pref' canary if needed.

Alice M.: Doing (1) and (2) now. Applying flag... done @1769004620. Route update in progress.

Carla: Also pushing a temporary kernel pin for high-latency paths: `kernel_hint=tiling-stable` to avoid oscillating fallback thrash while we investigate. Applying to canary nodes.

DevBot: Change accepted. rollout: feature flag toggled by Alice M. at 1769004620. Route update queued.

Ben (on-call): Monitoring metrics — p95 dropping from ~1.2s -> ~320ms after flag flip. KV miss rate still high but trending down as routing migrates and we reduce batch sizes.

Alice M.: Follow-up action: create a perf card to fix batching heuristic: cap by effective token-length and per-client QPS; add unit tests for exponential backoff behavior; add regression test for kernel-selection stability. I'll open PR and tag eng-runtime.

Carla: Add a short-term network-level rate-limit on the client IP range as a bridge if the customer doesn't patch their SDK. Also schedule postmortem to track how kernel-selection heuristics + KV eviction interplay caused amplification.

Ben (on-call): Good. I'll keep watch for 30m. If p95 < 400ms and no further throttles, we'll mark incident mitigated and start RCA.

DevBot: Incident INC-2026-045 status: mitigated. Last update 1769005010.
